items.title: The Property Owner's Guide
items.summary: 4-page leave-behind from your New Branding kit. Use after a rental review or with every new owner lead.
items.when: Discovery call, rental analysis follow-up, onboarding packet

items.title: RTB-1 Residential Tenancy Agreement
items.version: RTB portal lists July 2026 — verify before each file
items.summary: Mandatory tenancy agreement. Replaces the 2019 copy in your old Dropbox folder.
items.when: Approved applicant — before move-in

items.title: RTB-27 Condition Inspection Report
items.summary: Move-in and move-out condition report. Replaces RTO-27 (2011) from Dropbox.
items.when: Move-in within 7 days of possession; move-out at end of tenancy

items.title: BCFSA Disclosure of Representation in Trading Services
items.version: September 2019 (current approved version per BCFSA RESA 23-003)
items.summary: For owners and clients. Your September 2019 PDF matches the current mandatory version — still download from BCFSA periodically.
items.when: Before providing trading services to an owner

items.title: BCFSA Disclosure for Residential Tenancies
items.summary: Combined disclosure for unrepresented tenants (prospects). Use instead of the old generic DORTS alone on rentals.
items.when: Before screening / application with each unrepresented tenant prospect

items.title: BCFSA Payments and Benefits Disclosure — Rental Property Owner
items.summary: Give with owner service agreements. Write "None anticipated" when applicable.
items.when: Owner onboarding, with management or placement agreement

categories.title: Rent with Robyn — rebuilt in toolkit

items.title: Compliance Foundation
items.summary: Licensing, Langley business licences, trust accounts, insurance and the go/no-go test. Read before anything else.
items.when: Before any client work

items.title: Property Management Agreement
items.summary: Stonehaus brokerage agreement with three service models. Replaces LANG/SH legacy PDFs.
items.when: Full management appointment

items.title: Tenant Placement Service Agreement
items.summary: Placement-only scope and fee (50% of one month's rent, $1,000 minimum, earned on signing). Includes managing-broker sign-off list.
items.when: Leasing / placement only

items.title: Disclosures & Statutory Forms Guide
items.summary: Every required disclosure and RTB/BCFSA form with when it is required and who signs. Form numbers verified against the RTB list (Sept 2026).
items.when: Reference for every file

items.title: Industry Research
items.summary: What competing BC property managers use — documents, service models, fee benchmarks.
items.when: Background reading

items.title: Property Information & Authorization
items.summary: Owner intake form — property facts, strata details, rental terms, showings and marketing authorizations. Placement package Document 2.
items.when: After the discovery call, before the agreement

items.title: Rental Application
items.summary: No application fee. No SIN field. Replaces the North Vancouver legacy application. Placement package Document 3.
items.when: Each adult applicant

items.title: Screening Consent (PIPA)
items.summary: Signed before any reference, employment, or credit check. Placement package Document 4.
items.when: Before any reference, employment, or credit check

items.title: Tenant Approval Record
items.summary: Landlord's written approval before the RTB-1 is prepared. Placement package Document 5.
items.when: Landlord chooses applicant — before RTB-1

items.title: Placement Completion & Handover Checklist
items.summary: Closes the file: money, keys, copies handed over, landlord's responsibilities from move-in. Placement package Document 6.
items.when: At every placement close-out

items.title: Pre-Authorized Debit (PAD) Agreement
items.summary: Optional automatic rent payments with cancellation rights under Payments Canada rules. Attach a void cheque.
items.when: At move-in, if the tenant chooses automatic payments

items.title: Monthly Owner Statement
items.summary: Itemized monthly report: rent, fees, disbursements, tenant deposits held in trust, GST and net remittance. Reconciles with the brokerage trust account.
items.when: Every month, per managed property

items.title: Strata Document Request
items.summary: Letter to request Form B, bylaws, rental restrictions and the move-in process before advertising a strata unit.
items.when: Onboarding any strata rental unit

items.title: Placement file checklist
items.summary: Internal run sheet — the working order of the whole placement package. Replaces transaction record chaos.
items.when: Internal run sheet — every placement file

items.title: Tenant Placement — How It Works (client one-pager)
items.summary: Owner-facing explainer: services, 8-step process, what gets signed and the fee.
items.when: After the discovery call or with marketing

items.title: Transaction Record Sheet
items.summary: Legacy Stonehaus internal sheet. Use the placement checklist + desk placement file instead.
items.when: Archive only

categories.title: Brokerage forms — confirm with managing broker

items.title: BCREA Privacy Notice and Consent (BC1002)
items.summary: Your July 2019 PNC is outdated. Use BC1002 (rev. November 2024) from your brokerage — do not retype.
items.when: Before collecting owner or applicant personal information

items.title: Tenancy addendum (legacy Stonehaus)
items.summary: Old blanket addendum. Rebuild additional terms per RTA with lawyer review; do not reuse early-termination damage fees without legal sign-off.
items.when: Draft new addendum from RTB-1 additional terms only
